observations: Photo 0 shows a grey and white sewing machine on a dark table.
The brand 'Jensi' is visible on the front of the machine in photo 0.
The machine has a foot pedal to the right.
The machine is shown in a home setting with a sofa and curtains in the background.
A watermark 'SHARON TAYLOR' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition, just buy and use.
claims.evidence: The photo shows the machine, but there is no video or close-up to confirm mechanical or electrical health.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have a faulty motor.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and the motor running.

risks.risk: The machine may have a broken needle bar or a jammed bobbin case.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine sewing a piece of fabric.

risks.risk: The machine may have a broken or missing needle.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the needle area.

risks.risk: The foot pedal may be broken or not working.
risks.proof: A video showing the foot pedal controlling the machine speed.

proof_requests: Close-up photo of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powered on and running.
Video of the machine sewing a piece of fabric.
Close-up photo of the needle area to check for a broken needle or damaged needle bar.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
